critique: Flawless execution of the vertical rectangular monolith Surf Clock. All 9 upper radial ticks are accurately placed with a completely blank lower arc between FRESHIE and CURL CURL. All beach labels and sub-dial text are sharp and accurate. The matte-molded navy resin texture is tactile and convincing, paired with rich mid-century editorial styling (Braun SK4 turntable, vinyl records, steaming Moka pot, and warm late-afternoon sunlight on travertine).
